decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the core architectural hardware business, it benefits from sunk development and launch effort and there is no clear evidence yet that would justify reversing course.
A handle family supports the firm's broad system offer, so management is likely to stay committed after investing in range development, tooling and market introduction.

Because it is a new design within the established offer, management would usually continue with it for longer rather than admit an early mistake when results can still be blamed on normal market ramp-up.
This product fits the firm's design-led positioning and recent investments, making withdrawal within a year unlikely absent clear failure evidence.
Another lever-handle family strengthens portfolio breadth across projects and budgets, which matches the firm's stated direction and encourages continued commitment.

The electronic access system is strongly aligned with the firm's move toward digital building organization and was publicly highlighted at launch, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal especially unlikely.
